items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Clifford Brown, I admired him and I study him, I study his records every day

ctx.x: Well, of course not, but how do you do it?

Well, I do it by practicing every day, and by listening. I don't listen to -- I listen to the new trumpet players all the time. The guys that I like, as I say, Clifford Brown, I admired him and I study him, I study his records every day and I see the things that he's doing that were not done back in the '20's. And I used to -- and I listen to other trumpet players. I run into quite a few great trumpet players, say Bobby Hackett, for instance, will -- he's slowed down a little bit, but he has something and I…
were great friends, you know, and I think I was responsible for Benny Carter taking up trumpet. I gave him his first mouthpiece.
